description: The maximum number of nodes in an individual MemoryDB cluster.

The maximum number of nodes across all MemoryDB clusters in a Region. This quota applies to both your reserved and non-reserved nodes within the given Region. You can have up to 300 reserved nodes and 300 non-reserved nodes in the same Region.
The maximum number of parameter groups you can create in a Region for MemoryDB.
The maximum number of subnet groups you can create in a Region for MemoryDB.
The maximum number of subnets you can define for a subnet group for MemoryDB.
The maximum number of user groups you can create in a Region for MemoryDB.
The maximum number of users you can create in a Region for MemoryDB.
The maximum number of users you can define for a user group for MemoryDB.
